changes: Use a single scrollable sidebar when pinned navigation cannot fit; retain the existing roomy-window layout.
Fit the Goodreads sheet to the available Mac display, with an explicitly sized WebKit viewport and a fully visible Done button.
Prefer mobile website presentation on iPad.

assertions: Actual Goodreads, Add a book and selected-book accessibility controls are each fully contained in the sidebar viewport at a reachable scroll offset.
Selected book, notebook, original note block and reading section remain unchanged.
Existing width bounds, narrow-window fit and hide/reopen detail identity pass.
sidebar.test_method: Never-shown native NSWindow, actual RootView, synthetic local library, accessibility frames and native scrolling; query each nested sidebar hosting ancestor.
sidebar.invalidated_attempts: Earlier root-only accessibility enumeration could not see virtualized sidebar controls and remains inconclusive.
sidebar.fixture_library_scope: Previously built ABI-identical native bridge used only for UI fixture execution; this is not release or dependency remediation qualification.

assertions: A 900-point fixture fits without horizontal clipping on a normal display.
A constrained display keeps Done reachable and permits legitimate website horizontal scrolling.
Website navigation, unsafe URL rejection, generic errors and persistent-cookie isolation remain verified.

scope_limits: Exact-source hosted builds and received release archives are required separately.
Actual Mac walkthrough is pending the new packaged app.
Physical iPad and Pencil, hardware keyboard/IME, VoiceOver and endurance are not established by these bounded fixtures.
